title: Homogeneous generators under maps of coefficient total tensors
statement: For a scheme W, a sheaf R of commutative rings, maps a:P→P′ and b:Q→Q′ of arbitrary unbounded coefficient cochain complexes, and p+q=i, the degree i map of the ordinary signed total tensor sends the homogeneous sheafified generator of x,y in bidegree p,q to the homogeneous generator of a_p(x),b_q(y). This holds at every site object, without flatness or boundedness.

source.place: Tag 07A4, proof of lemma-pullback-tensor-product; Tag 06YS for K-flat resolutions; ordinary sheaf tensor pullback in modules on sites, Tag 03EL.

proof.text: On each bidegree, the defining map of the total tensor commutes with the summand inclusion and is tensorHom of the two component maps.
Naturality of tensor sheafification sends pure tensors to pure tensors of images. Apply the target summand inclusion.

theorem coefficientTotalTensor_map_generator (W : Scheme.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    {P Q P' Q' : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules W R) ℤ}
    (a : P ⟶ P') (b : Q ⟶ Q') (p q i : ℤ) (h : p + q = i) (V : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (x : (P.X p).val.obj V) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj V) :
    (((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology W) R).map
      (Prod.mkHom a b)).f i).val.app V
        (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology W) R P Q p q i h V x y) =
      coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology W) R P' Q' p q i h V
        ((a.f p).val.app V x) ((b.f q).val.app V y)
